entities.name: Eleutherian Adventurers and English Settlement
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: English Puritans from Bermuda, known as the Eleutherian Adventurers, established the first permanent European settlement on the island they named Eleuthera in 1648, seeking religious freedom.
